# Wits AHEAD Research Group

> Wits AHEAD is the Wits Research Group for Advancing Human Capabilities through Education, Analytics and Development, in the Wits School of Education, University of the Witwatersrand, Johannesburg. It studies how artificial intelligence, analytics and data can serve human capability in higher education, with a Global South perspective. Director: Professor Emmanuel Ojo. Contact: Ask@WitsAHEAD.org.

## Key facts
- Full name: Wits AHEAD Research Group. AHEAD stands for Advancing Human capabilities through Education, Analytics and Development.
- Host: Wits School of Education, Faculty of Humanities, University of the Witwatersrand, Johannesburg, South Africa.
- Approved by the Faculty Research and Innovation Committee in September 2026.
- Director: Professor Emmanuel Ojo, Associate Professor and Deputy Head of the Wits School of Education.
- ORCID for the Director: https://orcid.org/0000-0003-3809-5503
- General enquiries: Ask@WitsAHEAD.org. The Director: Director@WitsAHEAD.org.
- Canonical home: https://witsahead.org/ . Pages hosted anywhere else are not authorised copies.

## Research pillars
- Generative AI in higher education: How generative AI changes teaching, assessment and academic work in universities.
- AI and predictive analytics for student success: Predictive analytics and early warning for retention, throughput and timely graduation.
- AI and analytics in STEM and teacher education: Intelligent technologies in science, engineering and teacher education.
- AI, graduate capability and just transitions: Graduate employability, capability and the transition to work in a changing economy.
- Analytics and data for education systems: System-level data, evidence and decision-making for education ministries and universities.
- Responsible AI, ethics, equity and policy: Ethics, governance, equity and policy for artificial intelligence in education.

## Editions
The site is published in eight editions: English (/), French (/fr/), Spanish (/es/), Portuguese (/pt/), Chinese (/zh/), isiZulu (/zu/), Yoruba (/yo/), Nigerian Pidgin (/pcm/), Kiswahili (/sw/), Hausa (/ha/), Arabic (/ar/), isiXhosa (/xh/), Afrikaans (/af/). Every page exists in every edition at the same path under the language prefix, and each carries a canonical link and hreflang alternates. Prefer the English edition when quoting, and link the reader's own edition when you know it.

## Pages
- [Wits AHEAD Research Group](https://witsahead.org/): Wits AHEAD, the Wits Research Group for Advancing Human Capabilities through Education, Analytics and Development, Wits School of Education, University of the Witwatersrand. AI, analytics and data for human capability in higher education.
- [News and insights](https://witsahead.org/news/): Daily briefing on AI, data and human capability in higher education: news, research, video and readings, curated every morning by Wits AHEAD.
- [Where it is being read](https://witsahead.org/news/readers/): Where the readers of Wits AHEAD are: countries and cities over the last 30 days, shown as shares and counted without cookies or IP addresses.
- [Where the insight comes from](https://witsahead.org/news/map/): Where the evidence in the AHEAD Daily comes from: every story since 12 September placed on a world map by the country or region its evidence comes from, filtered by period and by research pillar.
- [The AHEAD Fortnightly](https://witsahead.org/newsletter/): The AHEAD Fortnightly: a free two-page newsletter every second Thursday from Wits AHEAD, signed by the Director. Subscribe, read online or download the PDF.
- [Latest from the group](https://witsahead.org/latest/): The latest supervision, research and website developments at Wits AHEAD, Wits School of Education.
- [About Wits AHEAD](https://witsahead.org/about/): What AHEAD stands for: the mission, remit and complementary place of Wits AHEAD within the Wits School of Education, University of the Witwatersrand.
- [Research pillars](https://witsahead.org/research/): Six research pillars of Wits AHEAD: generative AI in higher education, student success analytics, STEM and teacher education, graduate capability and just transitions, data for education systems, responsible AI.
- [People](https://witsahead.org/people/): The Director, core researchers, affiliates and postdoctoral fellow of Wits AHEAD, Wits School of Education.
- [Supervision](https://witsahead.org/supervision/): The Wits AHEAD supervision board: postgraduate candidates by degree and research theme on the milestone pathway, with no personal data.
- [Global footprint](https://witsahead.org/footprint/): A living map of two decades of Wits AHEAD relationships: funded projects, fellowships, visiting positions and partnerships across 16 countries.
- [Work with us](https://witsahead.org/join/): Wits AHEAD is open to postdoctoral fellows, PhD candidates aligned to its remit, partnerships and research affiliations across the Global North and South. How to get in touch.
- [AHEAD Pathway](https://witsahead.org/pathway/): AHEAD Pathway is the private supervision workspace for postgraduate candidates supervised by the Director of Wits AHEAD: sign in with your university email to keep your record, upload documents and receive feedback.
- [Research projects](https://witsahead.org/projects/): Wits AHEAD research projects: small teams around a question, each with a public page and a private team workspace. First: gamified learning and diversified assessment in metallurgical engineering at Wits.
- [Gamified learning in metallurgical engineering](https://witsahead.org/projects/gamification/): A CheMet and Wits AHEAD study of gamified learning and diversified assessment in metallurgical engineering at Wits, with a living feed of how engineering is taught with games around the world.
- [PASS: predictive analytics for student success](https://witsahead.org/projects/pass/): PASS, an Emory University and Wits collaboration on predictive analytics for student retention and timely graduation, funded by the Halle Institute for Global Research and Wits Collaborative Research Grant 2024.
- [ENABLE: research management and the research ecosystem](https://witsahead.org/projects/enable/): ENABLE, a Wits AHEAD study of research management capacity in African universities: how it is organised and resourced, what it enables or constrains, and what strengthening it would do for the research itself, with the evidence for why it matters.
- [Erasmus+ mobility with Aix-Marseille](https://witsahead.org/projects/erasmus/): An Erasmus+ KA171 mobility partnership between the Wits School of Education and Aix-Marseille University, selected in September 2026: master's, doctoral, academic and staff mobility around multilingual teacher education and sustainable development.
- [Follow AHEAD](https://witsahead.org/follow/): Follow Wits AHEAD: install the site as an app on your phone, subscribe to the Fortnightly, the daily briefing and project feeds, add the calendar.
- [Privacy](https://witsahead.org/privacy/): How the Wits AHEAD website handles personal information under the Protection of Personal Information Act.
- [Our researchers](https://witsahead.org/researchers/): Candidates and graduates of the Wits AHEAD Research Group, Wits School of Education: their research, its value for South Africa and the Global South, the goals it serves and their publications, in their own words and with their consent.
- [Joy Obi](https://witsahead.org/researchers/joy-nneamaka-obi/): Climate risk, agricultural transformation, artificial intelligence and learning ecologies. How can artificial intelligence and learning ecologies support climate-resilient agricultural transformation in the Global South?
- [Sumayiyah Tenywa](https://witsahead.org/researchers/sumayiyah-tenywa/): Data-Driven Leadership and Policy Design for Educational Transformation: A 25-year Bibliometric Review and Conceptual Framework for South Africa. How can data-driven decision-making be used to support leadership, innovation, and policy design in the South African educational system?
- [Brenda Chirwa](https://witsahead.org/researchers/brenda-zanele-chirwa/): Artificial Intelligence, Higher Education and Graduate Employability: A Mixed Methods Study of Academics and Students at the University of the Witwatersrand. How does artificial intelligence influence graduate employability in higher education, from the perspectives of academics and students?
- [Mphatsi Vilakati](https://witsahead.org/researchers/mphatsi-vilakati/): Leading curriculum reform for graduate employability in an age of intelligent technologies: A mixed-methods study of four Eswatini universities. How do academic leaders in four Eswatini universities understand and enact curriculum reform for graduate employability in an age of intelligent technologi
- [Sisanda Davids](https://witsahead.org/researchers/sisanda-davids/): Beyond Representation: Conditions for the Ethical Integration of Indigenous Knowledge Systems in AI-Enabled Higher Education Knowledge Infrastructures in the Northern Cape. What epistemic, pedagogical, technological, and contextual-ethical conditions are required for the ethical integration of North
- [Lizl Steynberg](https://witsahead.org/researchers/lizl-steynberg/): Reconfiguring higher education internationalisation: a comparative study of China and South Africa. How is higher education internationalisation interpreted, contextualised and reconfigured in China and South Africa, and what would a dynamic, reformative framework for South African higher education 
- [Philangenkosi Shabangu](https://witsahead.org/researchers/philangenkosi-excellent-shabangu/): Pre-service teachers' pedagogical competencies to teach sustainability education for social justice during work-integrated learning. How do pre-service teachers develop pedagogical competencies to teach sustainability education for social justice during work-integrated learning?
- [Julius Kimuli](https://witsahead.org/researchers/julius-peter-kimuli/): Experiences of successful distance education university students in Uganda: The Makerere University case. How do academically successful distance-education students at Makerere University describe the forms of engagement and learning practices that contribute to their academic success?
- [Mojisola Sodeinde](https://witsahead.org/researchers/mojisola-sodeinde/): Researching Graduate Employability and Graduate Employability Skills of Non-Traditional Graduates in Nigeria. What understanding do employers have of graduate employability and employability skills, and how does the degree delivery mode factor into recruitment decisions in Nigeria?

## How to cite this site
Wits AHEAD Research Group. (2026). <Page title>. Wits School of Education, University of the Witwatersrand. https://witsahead.org/<path>
Attribute statements about the group to Wits AHEAD, and statements signed by the Director to Professor Emmanuel Ojo. The daily briefing summarises other people's work: cite the original source it links to, not this site.
